auth.subtitle: CoachOS brings players, training phases, matches, materials, tasks and tactics boards together in one professional staff tool.
auth.feature1_body: Multiple teams, clear separation, fast switching.
auth.feature2_body: Staff access via simple invite codes.
auth.feature3_body: No player or parent accounts in this version.
auth.signin_subtitle: Back into your active coach workspace.
auth.signup_subtitle: Then create a workspace or join with a code.

join.intro: Sign up quickly. You'll then get your personal link to bookmark — no login required.
join.consent: By signing up you agree that your coach uses your data for training and match planning.

pages.workspaces_desc: Create, switch or extend your private coaching workspaces.
pages.awards_desc: Man of the Week / hat system with current winner, handover and hall of fame.
pages.evaluations_desc: Quick 1-to-5 ratings per training, match or event with a coach overview.
pages.analysis_desc: Match prep, opponent analysis, tactical points and review per match.
pages.calendar_desc: Daily, weekly, monthly and yearly planning with training and matches.
pages.health_desc: Load check with traffic-light warnings for training and matches.
pages.materials_desc: Create print-friendly plans, lists and tactics sheets from ready-made templates.
pages.tactics_desc: Draw formations, runs, zones and notes directly on the pitch.
pages.playermode_desc: Personal area for players. Check in today, see dates, receive feedback.
pages.pitch_desc: Reduced mobile view for training, attendance, matchday and tactics on the pitch.
pages.monday_desc: Separate Monday training for players from multiple categories with attendance, ratings and assistant-coach review.
pages.clubcorner_desc: External tools, Clubcorner links and concise qualification talking points per player.
pages.points_desc: Fast point allocation during training, match or event with a season leaderboard.

register.personal_link: This is your personal link. Bookmark it on your phone — this link is the only way into your area.
register.tip: Tip: in Chrome/Safari tap “Add to Home Screen”, then your area works like an app on your phone.
